trades.reason: Swaps Luka, Durant, Sharpe for Giannis and Sabonis (+4.8/wk); they fix PG with Luka (+2.7) and C with Sharpe (+7.2) but lose PF.
Lendeborg's 46.1 projection upgrades our SF by 10/wk, netting +6.4 locked. For them, Carter and Sharpe fill C spots over Marshall and Larsson (+8.8, +7.2), though White's SG drop costs 11.1.
Same +6.4 for us and +4.0 for them as the base offer, with Hayes added. His 26.0 projection is shaky: 15 games, last three 30/48/16, and game-time decision (GTD). For them, it adds C/PF depth.
Thompson (+5.3 at F) drives our gain since Morant is out four games; they fill UTIL with White (+5.8) and get Gobert at C.
Fixes their SG and UTIL: Jerome adds +14.1/wk at SG and Sharpe adds +7.2/wk at UTIL, offsetting Giannis's -16.4/wk PG drop.
We gain +2.2/wk: Giannis at PF adds +37.9, offsetting Luka's loss; for them, Luka fixes PG (+25.5) but Duren costs -30.9 at C.

Flagg (54.3) replaces Sharpe at F for +16.8/wk, offsetting Jerome's 12.4/wk loss at SG, for +5.5 locked. This week nets us nothing (0.0) while they gain +11.1; the trade mainly fixes their C spot with Sharpe over Larsson (+7.2).
Maxey (+14.7 at UTIL) drives our +4.9/wk, though this week we dip; they gain Carter at UTIL (+6.9) while Okongwu's C slot drops 8.6 from Maxey.

Thompson (40.8, blended from last season's 32.1 with a hot 56.5 in one game) replaces Carter at F for +5.5/wk, adding +4.8 locked for us. For them, White at UTIL over Eason gains 5.8/wk, though losing Thompson at C costs 5.5/wk.
